alt: A split paper-cutout scene. On the left, a worried paper figure leans away from a small robot that points a crooked arrow at a ballot box. On the right, a worried figure reaches up at a schoolhouse whose roof sign reads AI TOOLS SEARCH, the two words fused so neither can be chosen alone. A thin vertical line divides the two halves.
